post.description: Create 1–10 new preparation items for one tenant. Not atomic. Requires personal authorized AAL2 session. Retry identical full body and original Idempotency-Key; never reorder after partial failure. No unattended machine credentials provisioned.

200.description: Independent row results. Inspect status and failure; previous rows may already be committed.

get.description: Tenant/MFA-authorized search across the preparation register, stable (sku,id) cursor. Search matches literal substrings, not SQL wildcard expressions. Pages are current reads, not an immutable export snapshot.

200.description: Filtered total plus current page. Both cursor fields are required together when paging.

post.description: Explicit create-only immutable snapshot for one active test customer. Each source item can be published once total. No production mode, credit change, invoice or inventory effect. Requires admin catalog permission and current MFA.

token.description: Returned once only on first creation; never stored in plaintext.

per_purchase_minor.description: Positive amount in minor units. Explicit delegation limit chosen by the authorized merchant administrator; enforced by SQL.

approval_threshold_minor.description: Zero or greater and no greater than per_purchase_minor; enforced by SQL.

valid_to.description: Later than five minutes from now and no later than 366 days or the delegating administrator mandate expiry; enforced by SQL.
